video.desc:
换攻
Ethan has spent two years loving star quarterback Ryan in secret, hidden in equipment rooms and never allowed into the light. When a leaked photo exposes Ryan's betrayal, Ethan finally lets go. Noah, the quiet teammate who has secretly drawn him for years, steps forward instead. Choosing art and a love that never hides, Ethan finds his own stage.
两年来，Ethan 一直暗中爱着明星四分卫 Ryan——这段感情只能藏在器材室里，永远不被允许走到光下。一张泄露的照片揭穿了 Ryan 的背叛，Ethan 终于选择放手。而那个默默画了他多年的安静队友 Noah，在这时向前迈出了一步。选择艺术，选择一段无需隐藏的爱，Ethan 终于找到了属于自己的舞台。
